001package pkg_NpcPack;
002
003import java.util.Random;
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005
006import pkg_RoomPack.Room;
007import pkg_ItemPack.ItemList;
008import pkg_ItemPack.Item;
009
010/**
011 * Character class
012 *
013 * @author Jeremy Augier
014 */
015public class Npc
016{
017    private String   aName;
018    private ItemList aInventory;
019    private Room     aCurrentRoom;
020    private boolean  aMoving;
021
022    /**
023     * Constructeur d'objets de classe Character
024     */
025    public Npc(final String pName, final Room pCurrentRoom, final boolean pMoving)
026    {
027        this.aName        = pName;
028        this.aCurrentRoom = pCurrentRoom;
029        this.aInventory   = new ItemList();
030        this.aCurrentRoom = pCurrentRoom;
031        this.aMoving      = pMoving;
032    }
033    
034    // ******** INVENTORY ********
035    
036    public Item searchInventory( final String pName )
037    {
038        return this.aInventory.getItem(pName);
039    }
040    
041    public void pickUpItem( final Item pItem )
042    {
043        this.aInventory.addItem(pItem);
044    }
045    
046    public void dropItem( final Item pItem )
047    {
048        this.aInventory.removeItem(pItem.getName());
049    }
050    
051    // ******** ACCESSEURS *******
052    
053    public String getName()
054    {
055        return this.aName;
056    }
057    
058    public Room getCurrentRoom()
059    {
060        return this.aCurrentRoom;
061    }
062    
063    // ********* DEPLACEMENT ********
064    
065    public void move()
066    {
067        ArrayList<String> vS = this.aCurrentRoom.getExitSet();
068        Random r = new Random();
069        int vN = r.nextInt( vS.size() );
070        this.aCurrentRoom.removeNpc(this.aName);
071        goRoom( this.aCurrentRoom.getExit(vS.get(vN)) );
072        this.aCurrentRoom.addNpc( this.aName, this);
073    }
074    
075    public void goRoom( final Room pRoom )
076    {
077        this.aCurrentRoom = pRoom;
078    }
079    
080    // ********* TESTS ***************
081    
082    public boolean moves()
083    {
084        return this.aMoving;
085    }
086}
